description: This file contains unit tests for the AppStateRemoteConfig component of the OpenClaw project. It tests remote gateway configuration updates, token handling, and mode/transport changes, ensuring correct behavior in various scenarios.

classes.name: AppStateRemoteConfigTests
classes.description: A suite of unit tests verifying remote configuration behaviors in the app state.

methods.name: updatedRemoteGatewayConfigSetsTrimmedToken
methods.description: Tests that the remote gateway config correctly trims whitespace from the remote token.

methods.name: updatedRemoteGatewayConfigClearsTokenWhenBlank
methods.description: Verifies that an empty or whitespace-only token is cleared (set to nil) in the remote config.

methods.name: syncedGatewayRootPreservesObjectTokenAcrossModeAndTransportChangesWhenUntouched
methods.description: Ensures that object tokens in the gateway remote configuration are preserved across mode and transport changes when untouched.

methods.name: updatedRemoteGatewayConfigReplacesObjectTokenWhenUserEntersPlaintext
methods.description: Checks that entering a plaintext token replaces the object reference with the token string.

methods.name: updatedRemoteGatewayConfigClearsObjectTokenOnlyAfterExplicitEdit
methods.description: Verifies that object tokens remain unless explicitly edited by the user, in which case they are cleared.
